parameters.name: BackSourceMark
parameters.description: The back-to-origin mark of the node group. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City, which is used to identify the origin of back-to-origin requests.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the node group.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the node group. Valid values:

- **protect**: a protection node group that processes traffic filtering.

- **control**: a control node group that manages cluster configurations.

- **storage**: a storage node group that stores logs and data.

- **controlStorage**: a node group that serves as both control and storage.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: LoadBalanceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the load balancer that is associated with the node group.

parameters.name: LocationCode
parameters.description: The location code of the region where the node group resides. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks on the node group. You can use this parameter to add a brief description for the node group.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
